old="""        others=[];csum=0
        for k2,sid in self.active.items():
            if k2==key:continue
            c=self.Cs[k2];
            if c>0:
                others.append((c,tuple(self.Vs[k2])));csum+=c
        self.max_active=max(self.max_active,len(self.active))
        self.max_edges=max(self.max_edges,sum(len(a) for a in self.Hadj)+len(others)+sum(len(v) for c,v in others))
        lim=csum+min(C,capxy)"""
new="""        groups={};csum=0
        for k2,sid in self.active.items():
            if k2==key:continue
            c=self.Cs[k2]
            if c>0:
                vv=self.Vs[k2]
                # frozenset as hash key
                fv=frozenset(vv)
                groups[fv]=groups.get(fv,0)+c
                csum+=c
        others=[(c,tuple(v)) for v,c in groups.items()]
        self.max_active=max(self.max_active,len(groups))
        self.max_edges=max(self.max_edges,sum(len(a) for a in self.Hadj)+len(others)+sum(len(v) for c,v in others))
        lim=csum+min(C,capxy)"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open('tmp/genfast_group.py','w').write(s)
